name: Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease
definition: Inherited motor-sensory peripheral neuropathy causing distal weakness, sensory loss, foot deformity and gait impairment.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostics and genetic testing classify subtype.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Progressive deformity may require orthopedic reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Inherited motor-sensory peripheral neuropathy causing distal weakness, sensory loss, foot deformity and gait impairment.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
